candidate_fix_calibration.recommendation: Do NOT adopt a broad family-token scan: R32-fam and R32-fam-pol both flag the canonical schemas (6 FP fixtures), because foreign-family words are legitimate in negative/rationale/metadata prose. The adoptable shape is R32-narrow: the declared load-bearing, non-exempt allowlist with 0 FP on canonical + negative controls and 10/10 catches of the S2 mutants. S1 exempt subtrees and S3 metadata need a polarity/provenance policy, not a token scan. PROPOSAL ONLY - adoption is lead-formulation's.
candidate_fix_calibration.self_falsifier: A canonical schema or legitimate-negative control flagged here falsifies this mode's calibration on that field; report the field as FP before proposing adoption.
